newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Miners from lignite mines in the Gorj county started pay talks with a government commission.
* Romania's government will take steps to help the population affected by violent storms which hit southern Romania last week. The damage was estimated at 200 billion lei.

* The Romanian Red Cross appealed to Italy's Red Cross to help the crew on board the Romanian ship Oscar 10, detained in the port of Genova since January. Romania's Red Cross said the crew's condition was "critical."
